newsitem.title: HONG KONG: DC Finance buys HK$598 mln property.
newsitem.headline: DC Finance buys HK$598 mln property.

text.p: Financing and property investment firm DC Finance (Holdings) Ltd said it has agreed to buy a property from Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp Hong Kong (Holdings) Ltd (GHK) for HK$598 million.

DC Finance said on Monday it had paid a deposit of HK$29.9 million for the purchase, with the balance to be funded by an issue of 378.73 million new shares, or 15.66 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$1.50 each.
On completion of the deal, the stake of controlling shareholder Irison Development Ltd will be reduced to 36.40 percent from 43.15 percent.
GHK's stake in DC Finance will be increased to 17.26 percent from 1.9 percent.
The property is a 26-storey building in Causeway Bay on Hong Kong island with a gross floor area of 53,394 square feet. It was valued at HK$605 million on June 18.
DC Finance said it would hold the property as a long-term investment.
Trading of DC Finance shares, which was suspended since June 18, resumed on Monday. The shares were up HK$0.05 at HK$2.00 in early trade.
